label: Contract-priced sell and burn v4 custom-accounting adapter
summary: Optionally connect the standalone contract-price and burn mechanism to a reviewed v4 full-consumption custom-accounting path.
requiredFacts: The exact v4 PoolKey, hook permissions and canonical market scope that opt into the adapter
How full-consumption returned deltas are backed, settled and conserved without stealing or stranding inputs
How contract-price execution, burns and executed gross quote-side volume bind to the applicable Fee V2 custom-accounting profile
The standalone contract-price and burn path that remains usable without this optional adapter
requiredFiles: PoolKey admission, callback and settlement specification
Fee V2 custom-accounting policy instance and custody reconstruction
requiredTests: Direct non-PoolManager callback rejection and exact PoolKey admission
Full-consumption delta conservation for exact input, exact output, partial fill and failure paths
Standalone contract-price and burn behavior remains unchanged when the adapter is absent or disabled
Fee basis, funding, custody, claim and no-double-collection checks for each canonical adapter scope
risks: Full-consumption custom accounting can steal inputs unless every returned delta is backed and conserved
Ordinary routers and quote providers may not simulate the adapter correctly
Adapter coupling can accidentally make the standalone market depend on hook or PoolManager liveness
